module.purpose: Provides the organization administration route layout and prevents non-administrative organization members from accessing nested settings pages.
module.summary: This server-side route wrapper loads the current request session, derives the user's organization role from either the direct organization context or membership data, and authorizes organization administrators or owners. Unauthorized users are redirected to the organization profile page, while authorized requests render the nested route content unchanged.
module.businessContext: Supports organization administration settings in a multi-tenant scheduling product. If authorization fails or is bypassed, organization configuration and administrative controls could be exposed to ordinary members.
functions: OrgAdminOnlyLayout (~L9-23): Authorizes organization administrators before rendering nested settings content

detail.name: OrgAdminOnlyLayout
detail.signature: const OrgAdminOnlyLayout = async ({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) =>
preconditions: The children argument is provided as a React.ReactNode.
Server request context is available through headers and cookies.
postconditions: If the current user is an organization administrator or owner, the exact children value is returned.
If the current user is not an organization administrator or owner, navigation is redirected to /settings/organizations/profile.
invariants: Organization authorization is determined from the session user's organization role, falling back to the matching profile organization member role when the session organization role is nullish.
Children are not rendered for unauthorized users.
edgeCases: When there is no session, no user profile, or no organization role, the authorization check fails and the request is redirected.
When the session organization role is nullish, the role of the profile organization member whose numeric userId strictly matches the session user id is used.
When no matching profile organization member exists, the authorization check receives an undefined role and the request is redirected.

errorPolicy.onInvalidInput: Unauthorized or missing session data causes a redirect rather than rendering children.

detail.summary: Asynchronously renders the provided children only when the current session identifies the user as an organization administrator or owner. Users without that role are redirected to the organization profile settings page.

specLiterals.role: Destination used for unauthorized organization users.

specTests.then: It resolves to the exact children value and does not redirect.
It redirects to /settings/organizations/profile instead of returning the children.
